descriptions.w3d_d28b_table_rebuild_800994b4: Table list rebuild: zeroes and empties the item vector at +64, resizes it to the service entry count (0x8015ae74), fills it through the iterator 0x8015aea8, dropping entries whose count is zero when +56 is set, whose byte differs from +60 unless -1, or whose kind differs from +76 unless 7, then resizes it to the kept count.
